text: Hello there! Here's your weather for Monday, October 26. Monday again. Let's start the week well! Here in Shanghai, the day will be full of sunshine. Temperatures will go up to 23 degrees, with a low of 16. Warm enough for short sleeves. You probably won't need a raincoat today. There are 5 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? A great day for the garden, or for drawing with chalk outside. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be dull and cloudy, with a high of 21 degrees. This week our theme is trying something hard. Hard things get easier with practice. That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
